t.zh: 相机拍同一个完好工件两次，读数也可能略有不同。检测规范给了容差，超出的格子才需要复查。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Even two photos of the same intact part can differ slightly. The inspection specification supplies a tolerance; only cells exceeding it need review. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 在差值严格大于门槛的位置标 1，其余标 0。
brief.en: Mark 1 where the magnitude strictly exceeds the threshold and 0 elsewhere.

naiveWhy.zh: 报警的位置应在门槛之上。交换比较顺序会标出门槛之下的格子。
naiveWhy.en: Alarms belong above the threshold. Reversing the comparison marks cells below it.

hint.zh: 对照一格刚好等于门槛的读数。
hint.en: Check the reading exactly at the threshold.

after.zh: 门槛把连续读数变成是否复查的决定；刚好达到门槛的格子仍在容差内。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A threshold turns continuous readings into a review decision. A reading exactly at this threshold stays within tolerance. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
